name: spark
description: AI electronics design for dev-board-plus-modules builds. A generator turns a list of modules on a dev board into a board that builds and simulates (/spark:build: parts, pin map with reasons, board file, footprint, tsci build, Wokwi diagram), refusing rather than guessing: no footprint, pin order or outline nobody recorded, no pin that cannot do what it is asked, a bus shared where a bus is shared. Five deterministic checks on the built netlist (vendor pin truth, footprints, BOM, physics, rules), a review skill that reads primary artefacts only and ends at a fabrication gate, a parts library with provenance, board definitions for the Seeed XIAO ESP32-C6 and DFRobot FireBeetle 2 ESP32-S3, and a photo-to-schematic reverse-engineering procedure.
